# Next.js Starter

> Production-ready, infrastructure-first open source Next.js starter template featuring React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS v4, WebMCP agentic browsing, and full internationalization.

## Overview

Next.js Starter is an open-source web application and template designed for high performance, accessibility, SEO excellence, and AI agent discoverability (WebMCP and Agentic Resource Discovery).

- [Homepage](/) - Main landing page, hero showcase, and feature highlights.
- [API Overview](/api) - REST endpoints, system routes, and telemetry schemas.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy) - Privacy notice, user consent, and data governance principles.
- [Terms of Service](/terms) - Usage guidelines, MIT open source rights, and platform terms.
- [Cookie Policy](/cookies) - Detailed cookie consent, tracking classification, and policy settings.
- [Contact Form & WebMCP Demo](/#contact) - Interactive contact form built with TanStack Form and WebMCP agent annotations.
- [Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD)](/.well-known/ard.json) - Formal ARD v1.0 specification catalog for autonomous AI agents.
- [AI Catalog Manifest](/.well-known/ai-catalog.json) - AI agent manifest adhering to standard AI catalog and WebMCP schemas.

## Technical Capabilities

- **Framework**: Next.js 16.4.3 (App Router with Turbopack) & React 19.
- **WebMCP Ready**: Declarative WebMCP forms (`<WebMCPForm />`) and programmatic tool registration conforming to Google Chrome WebMCP and ARD standards.
- **Universal Orama Search**: Native full-text search engine executing in browser memory via static prebuilt index files, requiring zero external search APIs or databases.
- **Strict JSON-Driven i18n**: All localized content (titles, descriptions, sections, legal policies, navigation, and UI strings) sourced exclusively from `src/i18n/locales/*.json`.
- **Privacy & GDPR Compliance**: Integrated cookie consent banner, automatic script gating, and structured legal wrappers.
- **Centralized Site Configuration**: Type-safe control via `src/site.config.ts`.
- **Design System**: Accessible Shadcn UI and Base UI components styled with Tailwind CSS v4 and modern CSS variables.
